text: Given a valid Abnormal API token and an existing case ID, when abnormal_case_manage(caseId, action="acknowledge") is called, then the tool returns the actionId from Abnormal's response.
evidence: uv run pytest -v tests/test_api_client.py::test_case_manage_acknowledge_posts_to_actions_endpoint -> PASSED (2026-10-30, dev/PRD-21219). Moved from test_tools.py (design's suggested location) to test_api_client.py to match this repo's existing convention for mocked-HTTP behavior tests (see test_remediation_status_reads_history_and_remediate_posts in the same file) -- execution method only, AC content unchanged.

text: Given an actionId returned by a previous case action, when abnormal_case_manage(caseId, action="status", actionId=...) is called, then the tool returns the status document for that action.
evidence: uv run pytest -v tests/test_api_client.py::test_case_manage_status_gets_action_by_id -> PASSED (2026-10-30, dev/PRD-21219). Same test-location note as TC1.

text: Given a case ID Abnormal does not recognize, when any action is requested, then the tool returns the standard not_found error envelope, not an exception.
evidence: uv run pytest -v tests/test_api_client.py::test_case_manage_unknown_case_returns_not_found_envelope -> PASSED (2026-10-30, dev/PRD-21219). Same test-location note as TC1.

text: Given a request to the server with no Authorization header, when abnormal_case_manage is called, then the server returns the same 401 behavior already enforced for every other tool.
evidence: uv run pytest -v tests/test_middleware.py::test_case_manage_requires_authorization_header -> PASSED (2026-10-30, dev/PRD-21219): a tools/call for abnormal_case_manage with no Authorization header gets HTTP 401 and required_headers == ['Authorization'], same as every other tool (middleware runs before tool dispatch).

text: Given abnormal_case_manage is registered, when abnormal_navigate(domain="cases") is called, then abnormal_case_manage appears in the returned tool list for that domain.
evidence: uv run pytest -v tests/test_tools.py::test_navigate_covers_every_tool -> PASSED (2026-10-30, dev/PRD-21219). This pre-existing parametrized test automatically covers the new tool once navigation.py's DOMAIN_TOOLS['cases'] was extended -- no new test needed; it would fail if abnormal_case_manage were missing from the domain index. Also manually confirmed via scratch/PRD-21219/smoke.py: tools/list over HTTP lists 11 tools including abnormal_case_manage.

text: Given action="status" with no actionId, when abnormal_case_manage is called, then the tool returns an invalid_argument error envelope, not an exception.
evidence: uv run pytest -v tests/test_api_client.py::test_case_manage_status_without_action_id_is_invalid_argument -> PASSED (2026-10-30, dev/PRD-21219). Same test-location note as TC1.

text: Given a live Abnormal tenant with the Account Takeover license, when abnormal_case_manage(caseId, action="acknowledge") is called, then the real response shape matches the tech design's assumption (or the docstring is corrected to match reality).
steps: Obtain an Abnormal API token for a tenant with the Account Takeover license
Find a real case ID via abnormal_cases_list
Call abnormal_case_manage(caseId, action="acknowledge") against the deployed service
expect: Both calls return JSON matching the shape assumed in the tech design (actionId on acknowledge, a status document on status); if not, the docstring/response-handling is corrected to match reality
notes: needs a real vendor account with Account Takeover license -- not available during design; per mcp-track.md 2.5/3 this does not block INT publish
